Global Translate Privacy Policy
1. Information We Collect We collect minimal information necessary to provide our translation services: • Translation text (processed locally when possible) • Voice recordings (processed locally when possible) • App usage analytics (anonymized) • Device information for compatibility
2. How We Use Your Information • Provide translation services • Improve app performance and accuracy • Analyze usage patterns (anonymized) • Provide customer support
3. Data Storage and Security • All data is encrypted in transit and at rest • Local processing preferred over cloud processing • No personal data stored longer than necessary • Industry-standard security measures implemented
4. Third-Party Services We may use third-party services for: • Translation APIs (when offline not available) • Analytics (anonymized data only) • Crash reporting (anonymized data only)
5. Your Rights • Access your data • Delete your data • Opt-out of analytics • Export your data • Withdraw consent
6. Children\'s Privacy Our app is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
7. Changes to This Policy We may update this privacy policy. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy in the app.
8. Contact Us If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at: Email: privacy@gloabtranslate.com Website: https://gloabtranslate.com/privacy

Global Translate Terms of Service
1. Acceptance of Terms By using Global Translate, you agree to these terms of service.
2. Description of Service Global Translate provides translation services including: • Text translation • Voice translation • Camera translation • Offline translation
3. User Responsibilities • Use the service lawfully • Respect intellectual property rights • Do not abuse the service • Provide accurate information
4. Service Availability • We strive for 99% uptime • Service may be temporarily unavailable for maintenance • Offline features available when online service is down
5. Intellectual Property • You retain rights to your content • We own the app and its features • Third-party content may be subject to separate licenses
6. Limitation of Liability • Service provided \"as is\" • No guarantee of accuracy • Limited liability for damages • User assumes responsibility for translations
7. Privacy • Your privacy is important to us • See our Privacy Policy for details • We collect minimal data necessary
8. Termination • We may terminate service for violations • You may stop using the service anytime • Data deletion upon termination
9. Changes to Terms • We may update these terms • Continued use constitutes acceptance • We will notify of significant changes
10. Contact Information For questions about these terms: Email: legal@gloabtranslate.com Website: https://gloabtranslate.com/terms

Global Translate complies with all major app store requirements:
Google Play Store: • Follows Google Play Developer Policy • Implements proper permission requests • Uses targetSdkVersion 36 • Complies with data safety requirements • Implements proper content rating
Apple App Store: • Follows App Store Review Guidelines • Implements proper privacy practices • Uses appropriate content rating • Complies with data collection requirements
General Compliance: • GDPR compliant (EU users) • CCPA compliant (California users) • COPPA compliant (children\'s privacy) • Accessibility guidelines followed • Security best practices implemented

Data Collection and Usage:
Data We Collect: • Translation text (processed locally when possible) • Voice recordings (processed locally when possible) • App usage analytics (anonymized) • Crash reports (anonymized) • Device information (for compatibility)
How We Use Data: • Provide translation services • Improve app performance • Analyze usage patterns • Provide customer support
Data Sharing: • We do not sell your data • We may share anonymized analytics • We may share data with service providers • We may share data if required by law
Data Security: • All data encrypted in transit • All data encrypted at rest • Regular security audits • Access controls implemented
Your Rights: • Access your data • Delete your data • Export your data • Opt-out of data collection • Withdraw consent

Global Translate is committed to accessibility:
Features: • Screen reader support • High contrast mode • Large text support • Voice control compatibility • Keyboard navigation • Color blind friendly design
Compliance: • WCAG 2.1 AA standards • Android accessibility guidelines • iOS accessibility guidelines • Section 508 compliance
Support: • Accessibility feedback welcome • Regular accessibility testing • Continuous improvement • User feedback integration
